subject: NexoraBook Air arrived with cracked screen - Order NX-ORD-60417
body:
I opened the box this evening and the laptop screen has a crack running from the top left corner almost to the middle. The outer carton had a dent on one side, so I suspect it was dropped in transit, but the courier's delivery person had already left by the time I opened it.

I paid Rs. 58,990 for this machine on 11 October (Order NX-ORD-60417) and it was delivered on the 18th. I use it for work, so I have been without a laptop for four days now. I have attached photos of the box and the screen so you can see the damage clearly.

I need a replacement unit sent as soon as possible, and I would like someone to confirm how the pickup of this damaged one will work. Please do not ask me to ship it myself.

Karan Malhotra
Andheri West, Mumbai
